title: FBI September 2023 Sighting - Composite Sketch
doc_notes: This document is an FBI composite sketch and description of a September 2023 sighting, featuring a photographic representation of an alleged UAP.

incidents.summary: Eyewitness report of an ellipsoid bronze metallic object materializing from a bright light in the sky.
incidents.quote: apparent ellipsoid bronze metallic object materializing out of a bright light in the sky
